#!/bin/bash
set -e
ulimit -c 0
unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XAUTHORITY
/usr/bin/codesign --force --sign - --timestamp=none --digest-algorithm=sha256 --identifier com.apple.dt.runtime.swiftCore --options runtime --entitlements /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/signed-compat-runtime-2083wv0o/entitlements.plist /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/signed-compat-runtime-2083wv0o/libswiftC6.dylib
/usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 /Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/signed-compat-runtime-2083wv0o/libswiftC6.dylib
printf "PRIVATE_COMPAT_RUNTIME_SIGNED_AND_STRICT_VERIFIED_OK\n"
